summary.one_liner: The page announces the 5th edition of the beginner Python book Learn Python the Hard Way, which adds data management topics for Data Science.
keywords: learn python the hard way 5th edition
takeaways: The 5th Edition of Learn Python the Hard Way is nearly complete and ready to buy, per the page.
It assumes the reader knows nothing and starts with the basics of Python.
It then teaches basic data management for Data Science.
The page says the data topics are useful even if you do not plan to do Data Science.
summary.summary: This is a short announcement page for the 5th edition of Learn Python the Hard Way, a beginner book. According to the page, the edition is nearly complete and ready to buy. It assumes no prior knowledge, covers Python basics first, then introduces data management for Data Science. The page gives no detailed table of contents, pricing, or technical specifics beyond this.
